meta.source: OpenPDK sky130_spectre transcription library (models/sky130.scs) + AC impedance verification runs (results/COMPARE_RC.md, 2026-11-19, ngspice-47 vs Spectre 21.1, tt 27C)
notes: rsh_nominal is the model body sheet resistance (sw_..._rs parameter, tt corner).
rsh_effective includes the head/end resistances of the wrapped subckt - it is geometry-dependent (extracted as R*w/l from the measured dbOhm table below).
Corner sensitivity (COMPARE_CORNER): res_high_po_rs 325 -> 370 at hh (+13.8%); see sky130spectre.md for the full corner set.
Resistor instances are transcribed subckt devices with explicit w/l; no m/mp parallel-finger parameter exists in this library.

res_xhigh_po.description: very-high-resistance poly (sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po); body resistance is voltage-dependent (sqrt+**2+tanh form)
